mapper.select: select bo.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, bo.OU_PARTY_ID, mcci.PARTY_ABBR ouPartyIdAbbr, bo.OUR_TRADER, mcct.TRADER_NAME ourTraderName, fpi.ISSUE_PRICE, case when fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' and fpi.INT_TYPE = '02' then sdl_sd.ITEM_VALUE|| '+'|| nvl(fpi.BP, 0) end referenceRateStr/*,当带入资产的息票品种为附息-浮动利率时，显示字段参考收益率*/, case when fp.COUPON_SPECIES in ('02', '03') then fpi.REFER_YIELD end referenceRate/*当带入资产的息票品种为零息/贴现时，显示字段参考收益率*/, case when (fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' and fpi.INT_TYPE = '01') or fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '04' then fpi.REFER_YIELD end rate/*当带入资产的息票品种为利随本清/附息-固定利率时，显示字段票面利率*/, bo.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT subscriptionAmount, bo.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount, bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, bobp.ENTRUST_ID, bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, bobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, nvl(eed.ENTRUST_NUM*100, 0) - nvl(bobp1.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, 0) avaNum, bobp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT, bobp.SETT_FEE_AMT, eed.INV_AIM, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME, bo.dip_Type dipType, ROWNUM rn from BID_ORDER bo left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on bobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpi.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_sd on sdl_sd.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' and sdl_sd.ITEM_CODE = fpi.INT_RATE_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = bo.OU_PARTY_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER mcct on mcct.TRADER_ID = bo.OUR_TRADER left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID left join (select sum(SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT) SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, ENTRUST_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE where IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRADE_STATUS != '03' group by ENTRUST_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID) bobp1 on bobp1.ENTRUST_ID = bobp.ENTRUST_ID and bobp1.PORTFOLIO_ID = bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID where bo.BID_ID = #{bidId} union all select bo.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, bo.OU_PARTY_ID, mcci.PARTY_ABBR ouPartyIdAbbr, bo.OUR_TRADER, mcct.TRADER_NAME ourTraderName, fpi.ISSUE_PRICE, case when fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' and fpi.INT_TYPE = '02' then sdl_sd.ITEM_VALUE|| '+'|| nvl(fpi.BP, 0) end referenceRateStr/*,当带入资产的息票品种为附息-浮动利率时，显示字段参考收益率*/, case when fp.COUPON_SPECIES in ('02', '03') then fpi.REFER_YIELD end referenceRate/*当带入资产的息票品种为零息/贴现时，显示字段参考收益率*/, case when (fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' and fpi.INT_TYPE = '01') or fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '04' then fpi.REFER_YIELD end rate/*当带入资产的息票品种为利随本清/附息-固定利率时，显示字段票面利率*/, bo.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT subscriptionAmount, bo.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount, bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, bobp.ENTRUST_ID, bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, bobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, nvl(eed.ENTRUST_NUM*100, 0) - nvl(bobp1.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, 0) avaNum, bobp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT, bobp.SETT_FEE_AMT, eed.INV_AIM, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME, bo.dip_Type dipType, ROWNUM rn from WFL_BID_ORDER bo left join WFL_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on bobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpi.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_sd on sdl_sd.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' and sdl_sd.ITEM_CODE = fpi.INT_RATE_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = bo.OU_PARTY_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER mcct on mcct.TRADER_ID = bo.OUR_TRADER left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID left join (select sum(SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT) SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, ENTRUST_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE where IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRADE_STATUS != '03' group by ENTRUST_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID) bobp1 on bobp1.ENTRUST_ID = bobp.ENTRUST_ID and bobp1.PORTFOLIO_ID = bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID where bo.BID_ID = #{bidId}
mapper.update: UPDATE BID_ORDER SET IS_CANCEL = 'Y',REMARK = #{remark} WHERE BID_ID = #{bidId}
UPDATE BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE SET IS_CANCEL = 'Y' WHERE BID_ID = #{bidId}
mapper.select: select sum(T.subAmt) sumSubAmt from ( select sum(nvl(bobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT,0)) subAmt, bo.FINPROD_ID, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID from BID_ORDER bo left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID and bobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID where bo.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and bo.TRADE_STATUS != '03' group by bo.FINPROD_ID, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID union all select sum(nvl(wbobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT,0)) subAmt, wbo.FINPROD_ID, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID from Wfl_BID_ORDER wbo left join Wfl_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE wbobp on wbo.BID_ID = wbobp.BID_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on wbobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID and wbobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID group by wbo.FINPROD_ID, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID ) T where T.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and T.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId}

select eed.ENTRUST_NUM*100 - nvl(T1.sumSubAmt,0) from ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed left join( select sum(T.subAmt) sumSubAmt,T.ENTRUST_ID, T.PORTFOLIO_ID from ( select nvl(bobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT,0) subAmt, bobp.ENTRUST_ID, bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID from BID_ORDER bo left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID where bo.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and bo.TRADE_STATUS != '03' union all select nvl(wbobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT,0) subAmt, wbobp.ENTRUST_ID, wbobp.PORTFOLIO_ID from Wfl_BID_ORDER wbo left join Wfl_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE wbobp on wbo.BID_ID = wbobp.BID_ID ) T group by T.ENTRUST_ID, T.PORTFOLIO_ID )T1 on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID and T1.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID where eed.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} and eed.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{protfolioId}
